mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2017-004.note: Wikipedia Quantum computing: 'As of 2023, classical computers outperformed quantum computers for all real-world applications'; no routine production use. Placed 2022; provisional miss, window closes 2027.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2017-005.note: TR article (Futuresource): 360 cameras 1% of consumer camera shipments in 2016, 4% expected 2017; Insta360 2024 revenue USD 780M confirmed (unit figures are the graders' inference). Niche, far below 5% of households by 2022: miss.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2017-007.note: FDA list confirms Luxturna, Zolgensma, Hemgenix, Elevidys, Casgevy (59 products listed, not 66). The hit rests on an approval event test that D16 does not provide; no grader shows 20% (or even 5%) of patients with targeted inherited disorders treated, and uptake of several (e.g. hemophilia) gene therapies is known to be low.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2017-008.note: Wikipedia Human Cell Atlas: 2022 Tabula Sapiens and companion studies; Nov 2024 collection 'a significant step towards assembling a first draft atlas'; incomplete. Substantial share by 2022, not complete within 5 years: partial.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2017-009.note: Wikipedia Mirai: Satori (Dec 2017), Okiru, Masuta (Jan 2018), OMG, Wicked (2018), Miori; Aisuru (2024-) 31.4 Tbps on Cloudflare. IoT botnets routine DDoS source from 2017: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2017-010.note: Wikipedia RLHF: popularised by InstructGPT (2022); ChatGPT, Sparrow, Gemini, Claude RLHF-trained. RL routine across AI developers about 2022-23, 3-4 years after placed 2019: partial. Reading caveat (automation framing) noted by both graders; label names the technique.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2018-004.note: Eurostat: EU enterprises using AI 7.7% (2021), 8.1% (2023, Eurostat news ddn-20240529-2), 13.5% (2024), 19.95% (2025). Above 5% within the window, 20% only 7 years after 2018: partial (D16 gap rule). NBER 3% figure not checked; not needed.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2018-005.note: Wikipedia StyleGAN: Dec 2018 release, Feb 2019 code and This Person Does Not Exist, Sep 2019 100,000 stock headshots, Dec 2019 Facebook takedown, StyleGAN2 Feb 2020. GANs the routine method for realistic synthesis within 2 years: hit (no measured share; low-medium certainty).

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2018-007.note: Wikipedia Allam power cycle: only the 50 MWth La Porte test facility (grid sync 15 Nov 2021); no commercial plant. Far below 5% of new gas capacity: provisional miss, window closes 2028.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2018-008.note: Wikipedia Zero-knowledge proof: deployments Zcash (2016), Bulletproofs (2018), Cloudflare (Aug 2021); no consumer adoption figures. No evidence of 5% of online users by 2023: miss (moderate certainty, absence of evidence).

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2019-003.note: Mirvie release (14 May 2025): Encompass predicts preterm preeclampsia, not preterm birth, age 35+, direct to consumer. No cfRNA preterm-birth test in routine prenatal care: provisional miss, window closes 2029.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2019-004.note: ClinicalTrials.gov API: all 10 tethered capsule endomicroscopy studies are pilot, natural-history or evaluation protocols (incl. NCT04275167 EED Pakistan). No routine clinical use by 2024: miss.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2019-009.note: WHO sanitation fact sheet: 57% used safely managed sanitation in 2022, 43% lacked it; no mention of reinvented or sewerless toilets. Pilot scale only, below 5% of target users: miss (window closes 2026).

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2019-010.note: Pew (25 Jun 2025): 34% of US adults had used ChatGPT in 2025, about double summer 2023 (~17-18%); 20% crossed about early 2024, 3 years after placed 2021: partial. Borderline: other chatbots (e.g. Snapchat My AI) might push 2023 over 20%, but no measure shows it.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2020-001.note: Wikipedia Quantum network: test networks 'do not yet allow for the end to end transmission of qubits'; Beijing-Shanghai line uses 32 trusted nodes; not standardized. Far below 5%: provisional miss, window closes 2030.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2020-002.note: n-Lorem site: 'experimental' ASO medicines for nano-rare patients, no scale figures; graders' patient counts (tens to low hundreds) unsourced but consistent. No evidence of 5% of target patients by 2025: miss.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2020-004.note: Wikipedia Senolytic: candidates 'under preliminary research, including some which are in early-stage human trials'; none approved. Provisional miss, window closes 2030.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2020-008.note: Wikipedia NPU confirms accelerators in Apple (c. 2017), Qualcomm, Samsung, Huawei, Google Tensor phone chips, but gives no shipment share; a search found no 2020-22 share series. Majority of new phones with on-device AI by 2022 is plausible from vendor lineups: hit, low certainty.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2020-009.note: Wikipedia Differential privacy: Census used DP to release 2020 redistricting data; deployments at Google (2014), Apple (2016), Microsoft (2017), Facebook/Social Science One (2020), LinkedIn (2021, not 2020 as grader A says). Routine at major data publishers by 2022: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2020-010.note: Carbon Brief map (19 Mar 2026): 819 studies, 967 extremes; >500 studies in the decade to 2024 vs ~50 before; WWA rapid studies within days. Routine at the placed year: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-001.note: Google blog (2 May 2024): passkeys used >1 billion times across >400 million Google Accounts. FIDO 2025 survey: 69% of the 74% aware had enabled a passkey (grader A misreads this as 69% of all consumers; ~51% of all). About 20% of users by 2024: hit, borderline on the date.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-002.note: Wikipedia GISAID: world's largest repository of COVID-19 sequences, over 14 million SARS-CoV-2 genomes by Jan 2023. Routine genomic surveillance across most national agencies in 2022: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-003.note: Wikipedia Form Energy: first Xcel contracts Jan 2023 (10 MW / 1 GWh each), Weirton shipments from 2024, no operating fleet stated. Far below 5% of new grid storage against lithium-ion: provisional miss, window closes 2027.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-004.note: Wikipedia AlphaFold: more than 40% of 2023 protein-structure papers in major journals cited AlphaFold 2; 2024 Nobel Prize. Routine in structural biology within 2 years: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-005.note: WHO Q&A (4 Feb 2026): pilots reached >2 million children 2019-23 (low single-digit share of the cohort in 2022); now 25 countries, >10 million children a year targeted, most below target scale. Below 5% at 2022, above 5% within the window, mainstream not shown: partial.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-006.note: Wikipedia Ethereum: The Merge on 15 Sep 2022 moved Ethereum to proof of stake, cutting energy use by over 99%. With Solana, Cardano and others, PoS is routine for well over 20% of the smart-contract industry: hit.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-007.note: Wikipedia Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir: 'Throughout 2022, only 10-12% of eligible US adult outpatients had received' it; >3 million US prescriptions in 2023; no later figure near 20%. Above 5% at the placed year, below mainstream: partial.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-009.note: Only evidence is one Wikipedia sentence that synthetic data 'has become a core component of the post-training pipeline' for LLMs, with no adoption figures; that is a practice of a few frontier labs, not a measured 20% of organisations training AI, and the claim's framing (privacy- and bias-safe data sold by vendors) is untested. Too weak for hit or any other verdict.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2022-010.note: Wikipedia Climeworks: Orca up to 4,000 t/yr (Sep 2021), Mammoth up to 36,000 t/yr (May 2024); Heimildin May 2025: capturing only a fraction, not offsetting own emissions. Negligible share of removal: provisional miss, window closes 2027.

mit-tr-10-breakthrough-2025-005.note: Wikipedia Waymo: 500,000 paid rides per week (Mar and Jun 2026) in 10 US metros; no share figures. On the order of 1% of US ride-hail trips, below 5% nationally in 2025: provisional miss, window closes 2030 (a hit by 2027 remains possible).
